Name: CHARMAKEMENU_LISTITEM_PARAM_ST
Description: Choices of the character creator's icon grids, option lists and settings (body type, age, voice, origin, keepsake, base template). A menu entry's Table ID names the first row; the choices are that row and the rows with the following IDs.

Fields.Name: Value
Fields.Description: Value written to the entry's creator value when this choice is picked (e.g. a part model number, an origin index); the current value also selects which choice's caption is shown.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text of the choice. 0: no text (retail: most icon grid choices).

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown on the choice's icon grid tile.
